# Kamaide Technology (KMD)

> Kamaide Technology (KMD) is an industrial equipment company specializing in electric motors, industrial pumps, and technical solutions for international industrial applications and projects.

KMD provides industrial equipment solutions for power generation, mining and minerals, chemical and petrochemical, environmental and waste management, pulp and paper, and water and wastewater applications.

## Main Pages

* [Home](https://kmdequipment.com/): Company overview and industrial equipment solutions.
* [Products](https://kmdequipment.com/products.html): Electric motors and industrial pumps.
* [Solutions](https://kmdequipment.com/solutions.html): Technical solutions and application support.
* [Industries](https://kmdequipment.com/industries.html): Industrial applications and selected project experience.
* [About](https://kmdequipment.com/about.html): Company and brand information.
* [Contact](https://kmdequipment.com/contact.html): Project inquiries and contact information.

## Electric Motors

* [Low Voltage Motors](https://kmdequipment.com/low-voltage-motors.html): Low voltage industrial electric motors.
* [Medium & High Voltage Motors](https://kmdequipment.com/medium-high-voltage-motors.html): Medium and high voltage electric motors.
* [Explosion Proof Motors](https://kmdequipment.com/explosion-proof-motors.html): Explosion-proof motors for hazardous area applications.

## Industrial Pumps

* [End Suction Pumps](https://kmdequipment.com/end-suction-pumps.html): End suction centrifugal pumps for industrial applications.
* [Double Suction Pumps](https://kmdequipment.com/double-suction-pumps.html): Double suction centrifugal pumps.
* [Submersible Pumps](https://kmdequipment.com/submersible-pumps.html): Submersible pumps for industrial and water-related applications.
